notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
- Automatic goalkeeper

- shoot on goal with effect: press move right or left (keyboard) to give effect to the ball or the d-pad right or left (with gamepad). 

- more dynamic players without the ball

- greater variety of goalkeeper dives

- corrected minor bugs

- changed menu button

- changed the background in the controls test

- removed the fog

notes.title: Update v 1.1
notes.notes:
- Changed the graphics of some buttons on the main screen

- During the matches, now the opposing teams move the center of gravity based on the score. If they are ahead, they retreat making it more difficult to score, while if they are at a disadvantage they advance the defense.

- improved placement of opposing goalkeepers based on their strength.

notes.title: Update v 1.0
notes.notes:
- Added the automatic change of the player during the pass, while maintaining the freedom of the manual player change. As soon as a teammate gets possession of the ball, you can control him.

- Added field changes between first and second half in the matches.

- Added the fouls and free kicks with the ability to pull effect to the shoot.
Fouls can occur only in the green zone of normal shots (just over half the field and outside the penalty area)
with free kicks from the limit and melee in the area.

Free kicks: SHOT button to kick and left or right to give effect to the ball while it is moving (if you are using the gamepad use directional cross for the effect)

- other slight improvements

- save system optimized.
